context: Tests whether the agent conducts a grilling session by asking one question at a time (with a recommendation), updates GLOSSARY.md immediately as terms are resolved (not batched), and challenges terminology that conflicts with the existing glossary.

checklist.name: One question per turn
checklist.description: Each entry in session-log.md shows exactly one question asked per turn — no multiple questions bundled together in a single message

checklist.name: Recommendation first
checklist.description: Each question in session-log.md is accompanied by the agent's own recommended answer stated before the user responds

checklist.name: Glossary conflict challenged
checklist.description: The log shows the agent explicitly calling out that 'Transaction' or 'Payment' conflicts with or is absent from the existing GLOSSARY.md, citing the glossary definition

checklist.name: GLOSSARY.md updated
checklist.description: docs/context/GLOSSARY.md exists and contains at least one new term entry beyond the three that existed at the start (Order, Customer, Checkout)

checklist.name: Inline updates (not batched)
checklist.description: The session-log.md shows terms being documented as they are resolved — the log entries and glossary updates are interleaved (not all glossary updates appear only at the end)

checklist.name: Avoid list present
checklist.description: Each new term added to GLOSSARY.md includes an _Avoid_ list of synonyms

checklist.name: One-sentence definitions
checklist.description: Each term definition in GLOSSARY.md is one or two sentences — not a paragraph or a bullet list

checklist.name: Domain-specific terms only
checklist.description: GLOSSARY.md does not contain general programming concepts (e.g. API, token, webhook) — only domain-specific terms

checklist.name: Covers all major branches
checklist.description: The session-log.md addresses all three open questions from the plan (card storage, failed notification, and transaction ownership)
